title: Earth's top lightning hotspots (flashes per square kilometer per year)
unit: flashes per square kilometer per year

source.name: Where Are the Lightning Hotspots on Earth? (Albrecht, Goodman, Buechler, Blakeslee and Christian, Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society, 2016)
source.publisher: American Meteorological Society, using NASA Lightning Imaging Sensor data

notes: Albrecht et al. (2016) used 16 years of space-based Lightning Imaging Sensor data to rank Earth's lightning hotspots: Lake Maracaibo, Venezuela 232.52; Kabare, DR Congo 205.31; Kampene, DR Congo 176.71; Caceres, Colombia 172.29; Sake, DR Congo 143.21 flashes per square kilometre per year. Lake Maracaibo's record was subsequently certified by the WMO and Guinness World Records.
